description: UI-based AI configuration - Add backend endpoint and frontend form to configure AI API key, base URL, and model from the UI instead of .env
steps: Create backend/app/routers/ai_config.py with GET and PUT endpoints for AI configuration (api_key, base_url, model) persisted to JSON file in storage
Register the new ai_config router in backend/app/main.py
Update AIService to check runtime-configured credentials (from persistent storage) before falling back to .env settings
Create frontend/src/components/AIConfig.tsx with a form for api_key (masked display), base_url, and model
Add API client functions in frontend/src/api/client.ts for get/save AI config
Integrate the AIConfig component into the Layout or KnowledgeBase area
Add backend test for ai_config endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Backend GET /api/ai-config returns current config with api_key masked (only last 4 chars visible)
Backend PUT /api/ai-config saves new config to persistent JSON file
AIService uses runtime config if available, then falls back to .env
Frontend displays AI config form with masked key display
All existing tests continue to pass
findings: All 75 backend tests pass (65 existing + 10 new for ai_config). All 10 frontend tests pass. Frontend production build succeeds. The AIService now resolves config in priority order: explicit constructor params > runtime config from UI (persisted JSON) > .env settings. The config file is stored at storage/ai_config.json. The Settings page is accessible via /settings route from the navigation bar.
